verdict.rationale: GitLab's core product is Git repository hosting, with docs confirming Git version control support, SSH keys and personal access tokens for repo access, and API for programmatic interaction; community evidence corroborates actual repo migration/usage (importing repos, commits, etc). Minor performance/reliability complaints don't dispute the core capability of creating/managing repos and browsing history. Missing for 10: explicit documentation snippet directly describing commit history browsing UI, and independent benchmark of repo management quality beyond anecdotal community comments.
